diagnostics.message: The EKS managed node group (aws_eks_node_group.this) only references the bare IAM role (node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.this[0].arn) and has no dependency on the role's policy attachments. Per the official aws_eks_node_group docs, the node group must be created after (and destroyed before) its AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy / AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly / CNI policy attachments exist, or nodes fail to register and EKS cannot cleanly delete instances and ENIs. No attribute reference or depends_on expresses this ordering.

The self-managed node group's Auto Scaling group (aws_autoscaling_group.this) launches instances using the node IAM role (via the instance profile) but has no dependency on that role's policy attachments. The worker nodes cannot join the cluster without AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy / AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly / CNI policy, so the ASG must be created after (and destroyed before) aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this; the graph shows no attribute reference or depends_on establishing this.

The Fargate profile (aws_eks_fargate_profile.this) references only the bare pod-execution IAM role (pod_execution_role_arn) and — unlike the node-group modules, which have no launch template to transitively depend on the attachments — has no dependency at all on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this. The pod execution role needs AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy / CNI policy attached before Fargate pods can run, so the profile should be ordered after the attachments; nothing in the configuration expresses this.
